name: MegaFon Tver Data Center
notes: MegaFon launched a Tver facility alongside Yekaterinburg; each site is about 800 sqm, 110 racks, 1 MW standard load with potential high-load rack configuration up to 1.5 MW.

name: Kalininsky / Udomlya Data Center
notes: Large nuclear-powered data center campus near Kalinin NPP in Udomlya. Sources describe first phase commercial operation, 4,800 rack spaces for Rostelecom/Rosenergoatom allocation, and total site capacity up to 80 MW.

name: BitRiver planned Tuva mining/data-center site
notes: Trade/news coverage of BitRiver's Ust-Ilimsk launch reported company plans for additional data centers in Tuva, Buryatia, and Krasnoyarsk Krai; no specific Tuva site, capacity, or subsequent confirmation found in this pass.

name: Russian Company commercial Edge data center, Tyumen
notes: Commercial Edge data center at Kholodilnaya Street and 50 Let VLKSM in Tyumen, designed for 62 active racks. First 32-rack phase was scheduled for 2025-09-01 and remaining 30 racks for 2026-07-01; Tier III certification planned.

name: DSK-500 Tyumen modular commercial data center
notes: Regional officials said an investor received a site near the DSK-500 technopark for a modular commercial data center, with 350 million rubles planned for the first stage and delivery targeted for 2025-2026.

Searches found virtual cloud/colocation service pages localized to Izhevsk/Udmurtia, supplier and design-service pages, and map listings, but no reliable public evidence of a concrete physical data center facility or active build in Udmurtia.

Searches found Rostelecom/MTS service pages and a 2026 project to manufacture cooling equipment for data centers in Ulyanovsk, but no reliable public evidence of a physical data center project or operating facility in the division.

name: Volgograd Region Center for Information Technologies prefab modular data center
developer: GreenMDC / Sunline Engineering for GKU VO TsIT VO
notes: Prefab modular data center for Volgograd regional executive authorities, delivered and commissioned in early 2018. Sources describe 26 600-mm server cabinets plus four 800-mm cabinets and useful load of 160 kW.

name: Volgograd Region Finance Committee scalable modular data center
developer: GreenMDC / Softline for Volgograd Region Finance Committee
notes: GreenMDC and Softline supplied a movable/scalable modular data center, model ScalableMDC TelecomOutdoorNGm, for the Volgograd Region Finance Committee in central Volgograd.

name: Yandex Vladimir data center, Energetik
notes: Yandex data center in Vladimir/Energetik. Contractor profile states construction period 04.2016-03.2017 and design for 2,880 racks; RusDevelopers notes first Yandex-owned Vladimir DC began operation in 2017 with 845 server racks.

name: Yandex new Vladimir data center expansion
notes: RusDevelopers reported Yandex plans to finish construction of an 80 MW data center in Vladimir Oblast by 2027, near the existing Yandex facility; local legal entity address given in Vladimir's Energetik microdistrict.

Searches found localized cloud-service pages, Rostelecom/MTS virtual infrastructure offerings, and unrelated government or supplier references, but no reliable public evidence of a physical data center facility or active project in Vologda/Vologda Oblast.

name: DataHarbour Voronezh
notes: Commercial colocation data center at Ulitsa Zemlyachki 1, Voronezh. AllDC lists commercial launch on 2014-09-12, 212 racks, total electrical capacity 2.2 MW, guaranteed power 4.4 MW, and Tier III-level engineering/security.

name: Voronezh Region investor-proposed large data center
developer: Voronezh Region investment authorities / to be selected
notes: Regional authorities are promoting a large data center project over 5,000 sqm as an alternative to overloaded Moscow sites, with possible locations in industrial parks including Maslovsky and Chernozemye, SEZ Center, and Pavlovsk priority development area; implementation period estimated at three years.

name: Yamal data centers on Gazprom production sites
developer: Crypto Energy / Gazprom / Government of Yamalo-Nenets Autonomous Okrug
notes: YNAO, Gazprom, and Crypto Energy signed a PMEF agreement to develop energy supply for digital infrastructure and place data centers at Gazprom production facilities using spare generation and low-pressure gas from mature fields; Yamal is described as the pilot region.

name: New Urengoy modern data center
developer: Government of Yamalo-Nenets Autonomous Okrug / partners not fully specified
notes: Regional coverage states a modern data center will appear in Novy Urengoy as part of Yamal's broader data-center development push; Interfax separately reported the governor pitching Yamal as a long-term data-center location because of gas reserves and cold climate.
